brief: A 9-second company timeline: a horizontal line draws from left to right; as it passes four milestones (2019 'Founded', 2021 'Series A', 2023 '1M users', 2025 'IPO') each pops a dot with its year and label, labels alternating above and below the line; at the end the last milestone glows.
checks: Does the horizontal line start at the left edge of the frame and move continuously to the right edge without reversing or pausing? (YES = good)
As the line passes each milestone position, does a dot appear exactly at that point and remain visible thereafter? (YES = good)
Does each milestone display its correct year and label text (e.g., “2019 Founded”, “2021 Series A”, “2023 1M users”, “2025 IPO”) with no spelling errors? (YES = good)
Do the milestone labels alternate position relative to the line (first above, second below, third above, fourth below, or the reverse pattern)? (YES = good)
Do the milestones appear in the correct chronological order: 2019 → 2021 → 2023 → 2025? (YES = good)
Does the line’s drawing motion ease in at the start and ease out at the end (speed varies, not constant)? (YES = good)
Do each dot and its accompanying label pop into view with a quick scale‑up/ease‑out animation rather than appearing instantly? (YES = good)
Does the final milestone (2025 IPO) exhibit a noticeable glow or bloom effect that persists for at least the last 0.5 second of the video? (YES = good)
Do all visual elements (line, dots, labels) stay at least a small inset from the outer frame boundary, with none touching or crossing the edge? (YES = good)
Is the spacing between successive milestones along the line visually even (approximately equal gaps)? (YES = good)
Is there perceptible motion or change in every one‑second interval of the video (no dead‑air seconds where the image is static)? (YES = good)
Does the opening half‑second contain only the beginning of the line draw, with no milestone, dot, label, or glow appearing before 0.5 s? (YES = good)
Does the final frame hold still for at least 0.5 second before the video ends (the last milestone’s glow remains unchanged)? (YES = good)
Are the colours harmonious (good contrast, complementary hues) and free of glitches, flicker, overlapping text, or rendering artifacts? (YES = good)
